verses.1: Be careful not to act unjustly towards others before they have a chance to present their case. Otherwise, you will not receive any reward from your father in heaven.
verses.2: When you practice generosity, do not act in a way that seems insincere to others. Just as hypocrites behave in public and during social gatherings, trying to appear respectable before people. Indeed, I say to you: they keep their reward hidden from others.
verses.3: And when you’re doing something wrong, it’s impossible to know what your left hand is doing, while your right hand remains silent.
verses.4: So, may you have mercy on those who are in darkness. And your father, seeing this in the darkness, will give you back what belongs to you.
verses.5: And when you pray, do not act like those hypocrites. They love to pray in the streets and in the corners of the squares, so that people can see them. Indeed, I tell you, they keep their pay hidden from others.
verses.6: And when you pray, go into your storage place and close your door. Then, address your father who is in the hidden place. And your father will give you back what you have asked for.
verses.7: They pray that they will not be confused like the people of other nations. They believe that by their elaborate language, they will be able to be understood.
verses.8: Do not become like them, for your father knew well what was useful for you before he asked you to seek him.
verses.9: Therefore, pray to Me. Father, our Lord who is in heaven, may your name be sanctified.
verses.10: Let your kingdom come! May your desires be fulfilled, just as they are in heaven and on earth.
verses.11: Let us make our own bread, our own food, today.
verses.12: And let you be freed from our debts, just as we have also freed those who owe us.
verses.13: And do not tempt us into temptation; instead, save us from the evil one.
verses.14: For if you abandon the sins of people, then your heavenly Father will also abandon you.
verses.15: And if you do not leave things to people, then neither will your father allow you to have any rights over them.
verses.16: When you fast, do not act like hypocrites and deceivers. Their faces must be hidden from sight, so that people who are fasting cannot recognize them. Indeed, I say to you, they should give up their wages.
verses.17: But when you fast, I will cover your head and hide your face.
verses.18: So that you won’t seem to be fasting for people, but for your father who is in the secret place. And your father, when he sees this in the secret place, will give you back what belongs to you.
verses.19: Do not store treasures on the earth, where they will be lost. Wherever they are stored, they will be stolen and taken away.
verses.20: You will store your treasures in heaven, where neither you nor anyone else can find them. And there, no one will steal from you, nor will anyone be able to steal from you.
verses.21: For where your treasure is, there also will be your heart.
verses.22: The “tomb of the body” is the eye. If your eye is healthy, then your entire body will be illuminated by light.
verses.23: But if your eye is evil, then all of your vision will be darkened. If the light within you is indeed darkness, then how much darkness is there?
verses.24: No one can serve two masters properly. For he must either hate one master and love the other, or he must despise one master and respect the other. It is impossible for anyone to serve two masters at the same time.
verses.25: Therefore, I say to you: Do not worry about what you should eat for your soul, nor about what you should wear for your body. After all, the soul is more important than food, and the body is more important than clothing.
verses.26: Look at the stars in the sky: they do not fall, nor do they gather together in any place. Your Father in heaven takes care of them. Don’t you realize that you are much more important than those stars?
verses.27: How many of you can add one year to his age?
verses.28: And as for clothing, what do you think? You need to understand how the prices on the farms increase. They won’t cut down on their production, nor will they decrease their output.
verses.29: I tell you that even Solomon, in all his glory, did not act as if he were one of them.
verses.30: But if the soil of the field, which exists today, and which is being used as a seedbed by God tomorrow, is treated in such a way, then it will not benefit you much, are you not wise enough to understand this?
verses.31: So, do not hesitate to say: What shall we eat? Or, what shall we drink? Or, what shall we wrap around ourselves?
verses.32: For these things, indeed, all nations seek them. Your heavenly father knew that you would use all of these for your own purposes.
verses.33: First of all, you must seek his kingdom and his justice. All these things will be given to you.
verses.34: Do not worry about it on the Sabbath day. For the Sabbath itself will take care of that problem. Her suffering will be enough for that day.
